cases.title: The Zodiac Killer
cases.subtitle: Serial correspondence, document examination and forensic comparison
documented: The FBI maintained an investigative file and performed latent fingerprint examinations connected with the Zodiac investigation.
An FBI laboratory report dated 28 October 1970 discusses latent fingerprints and impressions submitted for comparison.
The FBI Vault contains a multi-part public release of Zodiac case records.

sources.label: FBI Vault — The Zodiac Killer, Part 01
FBI Vault — Latent fingerprint report, Part 04

cases.title: D. B. Cooper
cases.subtitle: Aircraft hijacking, ransom evidence and geographic reconstruction
documented: On 24 November 1971, a man using the name Dan Cooper bought a one-way ticket to Seattle and hijacked a flight.
He received ransom money and parachutes, then jumped from the aircraft while it was in flight.
The FBI's public release describes investigative files covering November 1971 through May 1992.

sources.label: FBI Vault — D. B. Cooper files

cases.title: Unabomber
cases.subtitle: Long-term investigative linkage and document-based identification
documented: The FBI Vault publishes two parts of the Unabomber investigative file.
The public records can support a document-centred case study of investigative chronology and evidence provenance.

cases.title: BTK / Dennis Rader
cases.subtitle: Correspondence, media contact and digital-media metadata
documented: The FBI Vault file describes murders in Wichita between 1974 and 1986 and a series of communications sent to media and police.
The file records renewed contact in March 2004 after a long period of silence.

cases.title: Golden State Killer
cases.subtitle: Forensic genetic genealogy and cross-case linkage
documented: The FBI states that forensic genetic genealogy contributed to the identification of the Golden State Killer in 2018.
The case is a strong example of how investigative leads from one analytical system require validation against independent evidence.

sources.label: FBI — CODIS and forensic genetic genealogy

cases.title: O. J. Simpson investigation
cases.subtitle: Forensic exhibits, laboratory reports and evidentiary disagreement
documented: The FBI Vault provides a 475-page release concerning the investigation.
The public file includes laboratory records relating to latent fingerprint examinations.
The U.S. Department of Justice Inspector General published a technical discussion of EDTA testing in the case.

sources.label: FBI Vault — O. J. Simpson, Part 01
